name: Conditioned Response (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at turning your defensive conditioning into offensive opportunities.

Prerequisite(s): commando conditioning class feature*.

Benefit(s): When you successfully make a saving throw using a bonus you gain from your commando conditioning class feature, you can apply that same bonus to the first attack roll and damage roll you make against the creature that triggered that saving throw, as long as that attack is made before the end of your next turn.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
